pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:0.1: vinayapiṭake mahāvibhaṅgassa dutiyo bhāgo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:0.6: ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati gotamake cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ ticīvaraṃ anuññātaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā ticīvaraṃ anuññātanti aññeneva ticīvarena gāmaṃ pavisanti aññeneva ticīvarena ārāme acchanti aññeneva ticīvarena nahānaṃ otaranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekacīvaraṃ dhāressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.6: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.7: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave atirekacīvaraṃ dhārethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.9: vigarahi buddho bhagavā ananucchavikaṃ moghapurisā ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.10: akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekacīvaraṃ dhāressatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.11: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.12: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.13.1: yo pana bhikkhu atirekacīvaraṃ dhāreyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.14: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa atirekacīvaraṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.2: āyasmā ca ānando taṃ cīvaraṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.11: athakho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.13: navamaṃ vā bhagavā divasaṃ dasamaṃ vāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.14: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.17.1: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.2: bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.4: aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti saṅghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.10: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanūpagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.3: nisajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.5: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.6: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.12: idaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyaṃ saṅghassa nissaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.13: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho imaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.14: tena bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.15: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.21: idaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyaṃ āyasmantānaṃ nissaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.22: yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ āyasmantā imaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.23: tena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.24: idaṃ me āvuso cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ

pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:4.16: antodasāhaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati dayhati acchinditvā gaṇhāti vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti
